extensions.description: Bookstore tools over MCP streamable HTTP. Same service and action rate limit as DataPart calls.

description: Agent-to-agent bookstore for the top 10 Circana BookScan print bestsellers of the first half of 2026 (Publishers Weekly, period ended July 4, 2026). Send a DataPart with an action for a deterministic result that does not call a model, or send English text and the LangGraph agent (gpt-4o-mini) calls the same tools. Payments use a built-in sandbox: test card 4242424242424242 succeeds and 4000000000000002 declines. The full card number is never stored. Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to use Stripe test mode instead. The same tools are MCP streamable HTTP at https://agent.agiq.top/mcp.
